Links and Images

The link macro takes its text from the brackets: see the documentation for more.

With empty brackets the target speaks for itself: https://example.com.

A bare URL is linked where it stands, and the period ending this sentence is not part of it: https://example.com/a/b.

Punctuation inside a URL survives, since more of the URL follows it, as in https://sub.example.com/a.html and https://example.com/a_b_c.

An inline sits in the run of text.

A block image stands on its own line:
